# SECURITY POLICY

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it by opening an issue or contacting the maintainers directly. We will respond as soon as possible to address the issue.

## Supported Versions
| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ----------------- |
| 0.0.1   | :white_check_mark: |

## Security Updates
We will provide security updates as needed. Please ensure you are using the latest version.
